method: independent source, contract, controlled-vocabulary, exactness, closure, historical-labeling and no-fallback audit
rationale: The rule binds a concrete cited 1230 Novgorod famine record at its source precision, represents the year as an exact calendar interval without inventing a narrower date, keeps numerical magnitudes unauthored, and preserves hidden-phase/knowledge separation.
limitations: The source gives year-level precision; the rule intentionally does not infer month/day, price, population, inventory or mortality magnitudes. Local effect magnitudes remain separate approved-profile dependencies rather than hidden defaults.
